image_description: A close-up shot of an adult bison and a calf standing in a grassy field. The adult bison dominates the left foreground, displaying characteristic shaggy dark brown fur, a prominent shoulder hump, and a large head with short curved horns. A smaller calf stands closely beside the adult's right flank, partially obscured but showing similar fur texture and proportions. A second adult bison is visible in the background, mostly out of focus.

The ears are small and largely obscured by the thick shaggy fur on the head, matching the description.
